reproduction_boundary: Historical operator cohort, not an automatic provisioner. Copy the consumer source package out of the Cargo workspace before building; its exact captured manifest binds this checkout path. Relocate only those path dependencies to the explicitly selected Kiln checkout on another operator workstation. Host/store paths and account/root names require fresh allocation and review; do not replay historical mutation commands blindly.
git_source_trust: The disposable account admitted only the exact root-owned immutable source store path via safe.directory, not a wildcard
host_source_boundary: Repository source hash describes the retained formatted source state; the consumer binary was built from the equivalent pre-format hosted parser source. Consumer/helper/wrapper source bytes are retained separately.
